content: {"phoneNote":"The opening-hours section repeats five identical full-width green bars with the same time, turning a one-line fact into a tall monotonous block that pushes the services and prices far down the page.","desktopNote":"The hero is sound, but the hours timeline and the near-empty dark CTA band leave large dead areas, and the huge footer wordmark competes with the real content above it.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Collapse the opening hours into a compact table or one line (Pon–Pet 7.00–20.00) instead of five identical bars; the timeline adds no information.","Tighten vertical padding on desktop: the hours section, the dark CTA band and the about block each carry 100–200px of empty space; move the service list higher.","Give the hero a real primary button for 'Naročite se na obravnavo' and reduce the oversized footer wordmark so the page ends quietly."],"blockers":["Desktop CTA band: the dark section opens with ~150px of empty space and a stray horizontal rule before the heading, looking unfinished."]}
